query: SELECT c.id FROM conversations c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.lifecycle AS kind FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=c.id AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.seq DESC LIMIT 1) latest WHERE c.state='active' AND latest.kind IN ('run.started','run.resumed') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_instances s WHERE s.conversation_id=c.id) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT $1
